gnyid stug gi snang ba gsum mngon par byang chub pa'i 'od gsal du dag /nyi khri chig stong gi las rlung mchog gi dbu mar thim ste/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang du grub pa thams cad kyang*/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas rdo rje 'chang kho nar brgyud pa sha stag yin zhing*/ de ltar rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub byed kyi lam yang gsang sngags bla na med pa'i shes rab zab pa dang thabs rgya che ba'i sngags kyi nus pa kho na'i mthu las grub pa yin no// de lta bu'i bsgrub bya gang zag dang sgrub byed chos kyi brgyud pa 'di ni bka' babs byin brlabs kyi stobs kyis rtogs pa don gyis 'pho nus pa'i zab phra'i gnad gsang ba las cher gsang ba'i don gyi brgyud pa mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ karma pa na rim gyi gsung rab rnams su rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rje btsun mar mi dwags gsum sogs kyi lung dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems tshad mar gyur pa'i lung ma gtogs sa skya pa'i zhal nas bya ba dang*/ bu ston gyi zhal nas bya ba dang*/ a ma lab ma'i zhal nas bya ba sogs mi 'byung*/ de bzhin du 'jig rten mgon po yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams na yang*/ rje gong ma phag gru pa sogs kyi gsung ma gtogs/ brgyud pa gzhan gyi zer sgros btang snyoms su las pa zhig yong ba yin/ de ltar mi 'ong ka med pa ni/ dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu las dgos 'dod thams cad longs spyod du yod bzhin du 'ching bu tshong ba'i rin la mi re ba ltar/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i go 'phang brnyes zin nas 'jigs bcas kyi lam ston pa'i ngag la ji mi snyam du 'jog pa las 'os med du grub pa yin te/ ji skad du/ grub pa'i mthar phyin 'khrul pa med// nor ba thams cad rnam par spangs// zhes pa ltar ro//

mdor na bod gangs can 'dir bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus na chos kyi brgyud pa mang bar 'dug kyang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam mchog gi sgo nas rdo rje 'chang du byon pa bar ma chod pa ni dpal dwags po bka' brgyud las/ lhag par karma bka' brgyud du byon pa 'di kho na ste/ brgyud pa mchog tu gyur pa gzhan dag kyang brgyud pa 'di la 'jug pa'i lam gyi steng mtshungs pa dang bral ba'o// de yang rje btsun karma pa rnams kyi nang nas rje chos grags rgya mtsho gdul bya'i dbang gis phrin las chung ba skad zer yang*/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma bgrang gis mi lang*/ rgya gar na mkhas pa chen po yid kyi shing rta dang*/ ma ga dha'i rgyal po sgra gcan 'dzin gzhon nu dang*/ kha che'i rgyal po dang*/ hor gyi rgyal po ming gzhon nu gon rgyal por grags pa rnams kyis bstod bkur bsngags pa'i gdan 'dren gyi pho nya snga phyir byung ba dang*/ dus der bka' brgyud kyi sgrub gnas gdan sar bzhugs pa phal cher yang*/ bka' brgyud 'di pa las phyi rol du gyur pa'i ston pa bstan pa dang bcas pa'i rjes su song ba'i skabs su/ sgrub brgyud so so'i rang rkang zin par bsgyur/ deng sang dwags po bka' brgyud ces bya ba'i phrin las kyi lhag cung zad lus pa 'di khong gi bka' drin yin/ ma go ba kha cig gis/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i dus rtog ge pa dang lugs tha dad du byed pa'i rtsod pa byung zhes/ skur pa 'debs pa yod kyang*/ de dus so sor ma phye bar nged rang khyad med zer ba zhig byas na/ deng sang 'o skol thams cad skyabs gnas rin po che bka' brgyud rtsod pa med pa'i mgon 'di dang bral ba zhig 'ong tshod du gda' ba las/ so sor kha cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtsod pas 'jig pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi 'khrug long 'di lhag par sdig che ba'i phyir/ so sor bye bas bstan pa la ji ltar phan snyam na bden mod/

de nyan thos kyi bstan pa nang ngam/ theg chen gyi bstan pa nang du chos dang chos ma yin pa so sor bye ba la dgongs pa yin/ 'dir rtog ge pa theg pa mchog tu khas 'che ba'i lugs de/ theg mchog phyag rgya chen po'i lugs kyis zil gyis mnan nas/ srol so sor bye ba gnyis gnad ga la gcig /de lta bu'i srol so sor bye bas bstan pa la gnod na/ dang por 'phags yul du/ dpal sa ra ha dang mgon po klu sgrub byon nas/ theg chen gyi bstan pa btsugs/ theg dman pa'i srol dang so sor bye bas/ khyed ltar na dpal mgon sa ra ha sogs kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan bshig chen por thal ba'i skyon yong ngo*// nged cag ni de lta bu rmi lam du yang dran par mi bya'o// mchan/ dbye bas deng sang skyabs gnas rin po che bslu ba med pa la gsol ba btab chog pa 'di byung ba yin/ gsol ba btab yul gyi sgrub brgyud rin po che 'di lta bu'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyang rdzogs rim thabs lam gyi man ngag thugs nyams su bstar ba kho na las byung ba yin/ rdzogs rim thabs lam de yang*/ pha ma dang gnyis med kyi rgyud nas byung ba'i sbyor ba yan lag drug dang*/ rim pa lnga dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi dang*/ nā ro'i chos drug dang*/ bsre ba skor gsum la sogs pa'i gdams pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su byon pa'i thugs la brnags pa de/ las can gyi slob ma'i rgyud la byin brlabs kyi 'pho ba thebs pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa zhig med na thabs lam gyi gdams ngag btab cing sgom par rlom yang tshig khrid ming rkyang tsam du 'gro/ lar na/ phar phyin pa'i byang 'phags dang sangs 'phags rnams kyang slar sngags bla med kyi lam la 'jug rigs te/ byang 'phags bskal pa grangs med du ma brgyud nas thun mong ba'i 'tshang rgya dgos pa de/ tshe gcig gis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kar 'tshang rgya ba'i lam bzlums sla ba'i phyir dang*/

lugs de'i sangs 'phags kyang slar sngags lugs su 'tshang rgya dgos pa'i phyir ro// des na rgyu'i theg par chags bral gyi lam gyis chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba'i rtogs ldan du grags pa'i rnal 'byor pa yang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa chags bcas sngags kyi lam du zhugs nas 'dod pa'i yon tan kun longs ma spyod par sngags lugs kyi sangs rgyas go chod po thob pa ma yin te/ ji skad du/ rgyud las/ dka' thub dka' spyad mi bzad pas// bsten na 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi// 'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas// bsten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gsang sngags rang lugs kyi mthong lam gyi rtogs pa thob nas lhag par thabs lam la 'bad dgos te/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo pa'i rim pa dang*/ nye rgyu'i spyod pa rlabs chen gdod 'byung ba'i phyir/ gtum tshig 'di dgongs gcig rnying pa'i gzhung yin yang go ba mi gsal bas/ gtum mo 'bar stobs kyis bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi rgyud la skyes pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i yon tan skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yin zhes pa'o// mchan/ mo de yon tan skyed par byed pa'i rgyu bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi yin te/ zhes sogs la/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan phyi rol pas kyang slob tu rung ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan nyan rang dang byang chub sems dpas kyang slob tu rung ba dang*/ lhag par bde stong zung 'jug gi bsam gtan dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma kho nas slob tu rung la/ gzhan gyis slob tu mi rung ba'i bsam gtan 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma khyad par du 'phags pas/ bsam gtan phyi ma 'di ni thabs shes rnam dag gi rlung gzung 'dzin 'gog stobs kyis ye shes kyi gtum po 'bar ba mchog gi dbu ma'i nang du zhugs pa na/ mchog gi dbu ma'i bcud du gyur pa'i chos can kun rdzob dang chos nyid don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bde ba chen po myong ba'i stobs las skyes pa'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin las phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes skyed par byed pa yin gyi/

de las gzhan pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan gang gis kyang phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes 'dren par nus pa ma yin no// de yang ye shes kyi gtum mo 'bar bas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i dga' ba bzhi pa dang bsam gtan bzhi pa las phyag chen gyi ye shes skye ba ni rdo rje 'chang gi bzhed pa yin te/ ji skad du/ thig le chen po yi ge med// stong pa chen po yi ge lnga// thig le stong pa yi ge brgyad// gnas brtan nyi ma dpal ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod 'grel pa las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo can zhes pa ni/ dga' ba'i bde ba'i bsam gtan ni dang po'o// mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba'i bsam gtan ni gnyis pa'o// khyad par gyi dga' ba'i bde gsum pa'o// lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i bde ba'i bsam gtan ni bzhi pa ste/ tshes lnga dang tshes bcu dang nya dang nya'i mthar thig le la mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i bsam gtan gnas pa de'i rtse mo mchog gi bde ba yongs su gang ba nyid de/ de 'chang bas na bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang ngo*// shes bya ye shes char rtog pa// dpyod pa de yi sbyor ba nyid// gsum pa dga' ba lta bu ste// bzhi pa bde ba bsdus pa ste// lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni// sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o// zhes pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga kun nas shes pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan yan lag kun shes shing*// zhes 'byung ngo*// mchan/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das// bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo can// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi yan lag thams cad gtum mo 'bar ba'i stobs la rag las par gsungs so// bye brag tu tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhes sogs la/ tshul khrims rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i tshul khrims ni sngags kyi tshul khrims sam sngags kyi sdom pa yin la/

sngags kyi tshul khrims sam sngags kyi sdom pa mchog ni/ 'bras dus kyi e waṃ dbyer med kyi tshul khrims dang sdom pa yin la/ de rgyud la ldan par byed pa'ang sngags kyi thabs lam kho na nyams su len par byed pa la rag las so// byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po zhes sogs la/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i dge ba bsog tshul ni/ slob lam du dge ba'i tshogs phul mthar thug pa bsags pas/ mi slob pa'i sar de'i 'bras bu rang gzhan gyi phan bde dang dge legs mthas gtugs pa'am tshad gzung du med par chos kyi dbyings ji srid par de srid du rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung ba yin sangs rgyas kyi sar dge rtsa rgyun mi 'chad kyang dge rtsa de rang gzhan la 'bras bu bde legs 'byung ba'i nyer len gyi rgyur ni mi 'dod kyi/ sems can thams cad mngon mtho dang nges legs thob pa'i lhan cig byed rgyu'i lhan cig byed rkyen du 'dod do// mchan/ no/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po nges bzung byas pa des spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la yang mtshon pa yin no// chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i tshe/ zhes sogs la/ gnas tshul phyin ci log tu ma rig pa'i dbang gis rang gzhan gyi sems can thams cad 'khrul pa na gnas lugs gang yin pa 'khrul pa dang bral bas gnas lugs 'khrul pa dang bral bar rtogs pa de'i tshe/ 'khrul bcas sems can gyi mi shes pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal mthong bas/ ma rgan mi shes pa'i las ngan gyi rgyu 'bras la bzod med du snying rje skyes nas rang gzhan gyi 'khrul pa thams cad sbyangs te/ mthar rang gzhan du snang ba'i sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byed pa yin no// brgyud pa 'di la'ang thams cad kyis rtogs pa dang ldan bzhin du/ zhes sogs la/ thabs lam zab mo bsgoms stobs kyis phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa de'i tshe na/

bde chen zag med kyi rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa rgya chen po 'khrul ba thams cad dang bral ba la dbang 'byor pa yin te/ dper na/ rje dus mkhyen dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim khar/ phyis 'bri chu'i ngo mthong nas skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa zhig gis kho bo'i dgongs pa rdzogs par byed ces lung bstan te/ phyis lo bcu gnyis na 'bri rgyud tsag tor grub chen karma pak+shi byon/ de mtshur phur mya ngan las 'da' khar/ sems can gyi don la dgongs pas gzigs tshul gyi cho 'phrul ya ma zung bstan pa ni/ la stod phyogs nas zhi byed pa'i ston pa cig mjal du 'ongs pa na/ kho bo khyod la gnas mal g.yar du 'ong ngo zhes de'i sras su sku skye ba zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ de dang dus mtshungs kho bo'i snga gzhis gangs zhur mo'i 'gram du song ngo zhes ma gshegs pa'i zla ba gsum nas lhums su zhugs te/ grub chen o rgyan pa la sku skye phyi ma'i bla mar lung bstan cing zhwa nag gnang nas mya ngan las 'da' khar/ rgyal tshab tu bzhugs pa'i dbon rin po che la sogs la kho bo dga' ldan du zhag bdun gyi bar du 'gro bas/ de'i ring lus la bsgul bskyod ma byed par zhog dang*/ de nas lus 'di nyid la zhugs nas sems can gyi don rlabs po che byed pa yin zhes bka' stsal te gshegs rjes slob ma rnams kyis zhag bdun song ba'i dgung zhag brgyad pa la sku gdung bsregs pa na/ dga' ldan nas sku lus snga ma la 'jug par byon pas/ zhugs phul ba'i thad kyi nam mkhar byon pa na/ slob ma las dag pa rnams kyis sngon rin po che bzhugs pa'i dus ltar mjal zhing*/ ma dag pa rnams kyi ngor yang 'od kyi phung po chen por mthong ba byung*/ de nas grong 'jug bya bar dgongs nas stod lung du lus rten btsal nas/ btsun pa lo nyi shu pa cig shi ba'i ro la grong 'jug mdzad pas spyan hrig hrig gyur pa na/ pha ma dag gis shi mig gson la ma blta zhes khab kyis gtsags pas/

long bas sems can gyi don mi 'byung bar dgongs te/ slar la stod du yum gyi lhums su rje btsun mi la'i bkas zhugs shig par lung bstan mdzad/ bar srid du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog nyid kyis dbang bskur ba mdzad nas/ yum gyi mngal shel gyi khang bzang du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi skur zla ba brgyad bzhugs te sku 'khrungs ma thag /tshes brgyad kyi zla ba shar bas zla ba la phyag mdzub gtad nas/ tshes brgyad kyi zla ba shar byung zhes bka' stsal pa po rje rang byung rdo rje byon pa yin/ des kyang hor rgyal po'i pho brang chen po shangs tor/ bde mchog gi bdag 'jug rgyas par bzhes nas mya ngan las 'da' khar/ slob 'di lta'i dben dkon mchog rin chen pa yin pas/ phyis shing kun kar sde'i tshogs dpon mdzad/ mchan/ dpon chen po gu'i gung pas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab cing*/ gal te 'da' na bu slob rnams gang du gsol ba 'debs zhus pas/ khyod de tsam du gdung sems che na/ kho bo'i skye ba phyi ma shar phyogs kong po'i rgyal khams dang nye bar 'ongs bas der 'dun pa gtod ces gsungs nas/ phyis kong po dang nye ba'i sa rngod a la go chen du rje rol pa'i rdo rje byon/ de nyid kyang byang phyogs hor gyi rim mtho ba'i sar sku mya ngan las 'das na/ bod la hor khrims kyi gnod pa dang bral bar dgongs nas/ kong po nas byang du bteg pa'i lam du nyang 'dam gyi ri gzigs sar/ sang da bzod ri pha gi'i mgul nas mi grags pa can zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs pas/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal gyis/ sku gshegs nas sku skye 'khrung ba'i gsung du 'phrig tshud de dge slong gnyis ri rgyud de lta rtog la bzhag pas sku gshegs gong nas 'ja' dang 'od dang me tog gi char pa sogs kyi ltas kyi sku skye phyi ma 'khrungs pa'i khang pa dang yab yum sogs ngos zin par byung*/

phyis nyang 'dam du chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa byon/ de yang skyid shod po ṭa lar mkhas grub chen po mi nyag 'jam dbyangs grags pa khams phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur bar gsol ba btab pa la/ rjes gshegs nas sku skye 'byon pa la dgongs nas/ da ci myur du mdo khams karma dang nye bar sleb pa byed ces bka' stsal pas/ phyis karma dang nye ba'i ngom shel gyam du rje mthong ba don ldan byon/ de yang dben gnas gsa' phur sku mya ngan las 'da' khar/ bdag nyid chen po dpal 'byor don grub la/ sham+bha la pa dang ma kha pa rtsod pa yod pas kho bo rigs ldan gyi grogs la 'gro dgos par 'dug /kho bo sngar mi gral du yod pa/ da bka' brgyud kyi gral du sdod pa yin pas/ gsol ba 'di bzhin thob ces/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rin po che// thugs rje'i bdag nyid mthong ba don ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// gsol 'debs byin rlabs char rgyun dbab tu gsol// zhes bka' stsal zhing*/ ka bzhi seng chen ma'i mgur byang phyogs kyi ka chen nyid kyis then nas/ gsa' phu'i byang phyogs su sku skye 'khrung bar lung bstan pa dang mthun par/ gsa' phu'i byang phyogs rngod kyi lhas su rje chos grags rgya mtsho byon/ de yang sku mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i gong*/ lo gsum sku mtshams mdzad pas dbu skra lcang lor yod pa/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin dbu skra thor cog tu mdzad/ mu tig las grub pa'i rigs lnga'i cod pan gyis dbu brgyan te/ kong po lung pa'i skya ser thams cad la longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshul gyis zhal bstan nas/ kho bo 'chi ba med la 'chi tshul ston// slar yang skye ba med la skye tshul ston// zhes sogs tshigs su bcas pa mang dag gsungs nas/ srod la 'od gsal ba chos kyi skur gshegs/ dus gsum gsal ler gzigs pa'i mdzad pa 'khrul med du yid ches pa dang*/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos kyang nyid kyi gdung brgyud gser gyi gnya' shing lta bu rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/

gling la gling log 'byung bar lung bstan pa 'khrul med du 'byung ba 'di 'dra ba bka' brgyud rin po che 'di la bgrang gis mi lang ba 'byung ba thams cad kyang*/ rdzogs rim thabs lam la gnad du bsnun pas skye 'chi la rang dbang thob/ las nyon gyi 'ching ba gtan zad du song nas sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du gyur pa 'di'o//

rje go chen bsod nams seng ge dpon slob kyi gsung gis/ dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams 'dir lung bstan byed mi mang du yod kyang thog tu mi phebs te/ rnying ma ba'i lho brag phyag nas/ o rgyan pad+ma'i gter bton pa'i lung las/ rje tsong kha pa nyid sku skye phyi ma dga' ldan du 'jam dpal snying por 'gyur ba dang*/ 'khor sa thob pa mang du 'byung ba dang*/ sne'u rdzogs pa mi rabs bdun na lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur bar lung bstan kyang*/ sne'u rdzogs pa mi rabs bzhi pa nas sde srid mi lus dang bcas pa chad/ rje tsong kha pa lta bu mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa des 'dul ba'i bstan pa skyon med btsugs pa lo nyi shu'i rgyun tsam las 'jags ma thub/ ri bo dga' ldan du brang khang gsum thog tu longs pa mi byed pa dang*/ gling gseb tu rta dang dre'u mi 'jog pa dang*/ thun drug tu mkhar rnga brdungs nas mdo sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i srol btsugs pa/ lo bcu nas las tshan gyi 'thab rtsod kyi dbang gis zhig cing nyams/ deng sang dge 'dun pas dmag sde 'cha' ba sogs bstan pa dar long med par btsan nub tu song bas/ rje btsun tsong kha pa de bstan pa'i rgyun dang slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob thub pa zhig min pa 'dra zer ba la/ 'bras spungs nas rje legs pa chos 'byor bas/ de lta na/ sa skya pa bstan pa'i bdag po yin zer gyin 'dug pa la/ chos rje sa paṇa hor rgyal bus gdan drangs pa'i stobs kyis/ 'phags pa rin po ches dmag sde bcas nas khrims lugs su ming btags/ dge 'dun dang gtsug lag khang la gnod pa ji tsam du bskyal/ khyad par 'bring khung pa'i ban khri tsho bco brgyad gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa brlag tshul de lta na/ sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyang bstan pa'i rgyun dang slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob nus pa zhig min par mtshungs so// zhes phan tshun ngan kha smra bar rlung ltar grags pa 'di ni/

sa dge ldan gyi skye bo sdang zhen can 'ga' zhig gis bcos par zad kyis/ rje go chen dang rje chos 'byor bas 'di ltar gsung ba ga la srid/ de ltar gsungs srid na deng sang chos byed pa tsho su zhig la skyabs su 'dzin par nus/ kho bo ltar na bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rje tsong kha pa chen po gnyis kyis bstan pa'i rgyun dang*/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob tshul/ phrin las rgya che chung*/ phrin las 'di lta bu'i bka' drin gyis sems can rnams bde skyid la longs spyod tshul 'di la mi dad pa'i skyes bu de ni/ dkar po'i chos kyi skal ba med par ma zad snying med pa zhig tu gor ma chag go / spyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos dang rjes 'jug gi mtha' bsrung ba 'di ched du bya ba chen po yin te/ bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i sngags kyi lam la 'jug pa na/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba nyid nan tan du mdzad pa'i phyir/ bka' brgyud rin po che 'di la/ rje dus mkhyen/ phag gru pa/ 'bri stag zhang tshal pa sogs bla ma rin po che re res kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i rgyun rje btsun byams mgon mi yul du ma byon gyi bar rgyun mi 'chad par byin gyis brlabs pa 'di ni/ e ma ngo mtshar srid do cog las kyang ngo mtshar zhing bla na med pa'i spyod yul du gyur to// deng sang kha cig bstan pa'i mtha' bsrung bar 'dod nas/ go mtshon dang bcas pa'i g.yul chen por 'jug pa ni glang chen gyis khrus byed pa dang 'dra'o/// / ༈ rdo rje'i gsung*/ tshul rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa byed pa na/ theg dman gyi gdul bya gdul ba'i ched du/ de'i ngor theg dman gyi tshul khrims la gces spras su byed pa'i sgo nas spyod gos zhes bton na rdor gsung lhad dang bral bar 'gyur ro// mchan/ khrims la gces spras su byed pa rigs spyod khyad 'phags yin/

zhes pa la/ 'di'i gzhan bzhed 'di 'chad ma shes na/ rgya gar gyi grub chen rnams kyis rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pa de spyod pa khyad 'phags min bya bar 'gro ba'i nyen yod pas phyogs snga na/ nyan thos kyi rab tu byung ba dge slong gi rten la gnas pa sngags kyi lam la 'jug pa na/ rig ma'i longs spyod la longs spyod pa sogs rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa nyan thos 'dul ba'i don lta bu ma yin par nyan thos dang lhan cig pa'i sder byar rung zhes zer ba de yin la/ de ltar na yang sbom por 'gyur ba yin te/ nyan thos nang du zhag bdun 'das// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ spyir sngags bla med kyi rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub pa'i spyod pa la/ dang por a wa dhu tī'i kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la gsang spyod dang rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'am/ tshogs kyi spyod pa'i smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas spyod pa las/ dang po ni drod thob pa bskyed cing brtan par bya ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni drod 'bring thob nas tshar gcod rjes 'dzin nus pa na spyod par gsungs shing*/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa de la'ang bskyed rim gyi sgo nas thun mong gi dngos grub kyi phyir spyod pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas thun mong ma yin pa mchog gi dngos grub kyi phyir spyod pa gnyis yod pa las/ skabs 'dir ni thun mong min pa'i dngos grub cig car du sgrub par byed pa'i spros bcas kyi spyod pa ste/ de yang yul chen so bdun la sogs par rgyu zhing*/ yul chen de dag gi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rang las lhag pa'am skal ba mnyam pa dag 'dus te/ so phag las byas pa'i lha'i khang pa gsum brtsegs gru bzhi rta babs dang ldan pa'i 'og khang du tshang mang dang*/ bar khang du gar ma glu ma sogs mchod pa'i yo byad bzhag /steng khang du rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su 'dug ste/

'khor lha mo nyi shu btsun mo dang nyer gcig /gzhan yang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dkyil 'khor pa'i 'dra 'bag tu zhugs nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi ā ra li chen po ste/ rtsed mo'i rol pa'i gar mdzad pa'i rim pas phyag rgya dang*/ phyag rgya'i lan dang*/ phyag dang phyag gi lan dang*/ mchod pa dang mchod pa'i lan dang*/ de bzhin du gar dang glu dang brda'i lan gyis phan tshun du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la phan tshun du stob pa dang*/ spel ba dang mngon sum du byed pa'i tshul gyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed pa ste ga ṇa tsakra 'dus nas bya ba mi zad pa sgrub pa'am/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khor lo gong nas gong du yang dag par 'phel zhing rdzogs par byed pa'o// de ni spros bcas kyi spyod pa yin la/ drod 'bring gi spyod pa 'di la rgyal tshab gzhon nu'i spyod pa zhes kyang bya ste/ rgyal tshab chen po ni drod chen po yin pas de ma thob pa'i phyir ro// drod chen po thob nas zag med kyi ye shes mngon du byas te gzhan don thogs med du 'byung zhing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i grub mtha' snyogs pas/ lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya ma rnyed na de dang lhan cig tu spyod pa byed pa ni rgyal tshab chen po'i spyod pa'o// de nas spros med kyi spyod pa la phyag rgya lnga dang lhan cig tu spyod pa bya ba dang*/ de yang ma 'byor na phyag rgya ma cig dang lhan cig par spyod pa'o// shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni ye shes kyi phyag rgya'am/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo la snyoms par 'jug pas rlung sems dbu mar bsdus te lhan skyes 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rang 'od kyi lha yab yum bde ba chen pos mchod pa'i tshogs sog pa'i spyod pa rlabs po che bya ba ste/ gsang 'dus le'u drug pa'i 'grel par/

slob dpon zla bas/ bhu su ku'i spyod pa de spyod pa rnams kyi mchog tu gsungs la/ dus der ni sgrib pa'i sa bon thams cad spangs te/ sprul pa dpag med kyis sems can gyi don grub par khyab cing*/ bdud thams cad zil gyis gnon pas phyogs thams cad las rnam rgyal gyis spyod pa'ang zer ro// sngon gyi bla ma gong ma dag /tshogs sbyor du spros bcas kyi spyod pa ma dag par spros med kyi spyod pa dag par shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa zhes gsungs pa ni phal che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa mtshan nyid pa'ang spyod pa 'di lta bu'i dbang du byas pa yin no// deng sang sngags kyi sdom pa dang dam tshig dang mi ldan zhing dbang gis rgyud yongs su ma smin pa'i mchog gi dngos grub kyi skal ba med pa dag 'dus shing*/ mngon dkyil shur tsam re/ spyir 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la 'khor gsum mi rtog pa dang byang chub kyi sems kyi thabs kyis zin pa'i sgo nas/ bdag nyid kyis longs spyod pa dang*/ gzhan rgyud du grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par mchod pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya bar phar phyin theg par yang bshad kyi/ gsang chen gyi lam 'dir ni bde ba chen po'i rgyur 'dod yon lnga la rang rgyud du grub pa'i lha dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin du shes pa'i sgo nas mchod pa'am longs spyod pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po tshe gcig la rdzogs nas lus rten de nyid la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'o// des na phar phyin theg par bskal pa grangs med du tshogs bsags kyang thun mong ba'i sangs rgyas tsam las mi thob la de'i tshogs sog pa'i spyod pas tshe gcig la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis ka thob pa ni tshogs la mchog dman gyi khyad zhugs pa yin te/

phar phyin theg par snang ba thams cad lha dang ye shes su mi shes shing*/ rig ma'i bde bas dam tshig sems dpa' lam gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas dbyer mi phyed pa'i rgyud tshim par byed pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs sog pa med pa'i phyir ro// de skad du yang*/ de ltar spyod pa gsum la zla ba gsum mam drug tu bslab pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi mtshan ma/ gzugs phra ba sogs dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad mngon du byed pa dang*/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bco lnga pa las gsungs pa'i rmi ltas rnams byung ba na/ spyod pa grub pa yin la/ slob pa mi slob pa'i mchog gi dngos grub kyang yun mi ring ba na 'grub pa yin no// mchan/ bton nas ma dag pa'i rdzas sha chang sogs bag med par longs spyod pa ni/ gsang sngags log par spyod pa'i chos spong ba'i las yin pas sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu ma gtogs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bla na med par rdzogs pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'ong sa gang na yod// des na rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa ma byas na tshe de nyid la 'tshang rgya ba ma yin te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// ji skad du/ gal te ches phra'i sems kyi myu gu la// dag pa'i yul gyi bcud kyis ma bran na// nam mkhas khyab pa'i 'bras bu mi ster bas// dpag bsam ljon shing 'di ni ji ltar thob// kha cig yul rnams dag ni spangs nas te// kha cig yul rnams ma bkag par byas nas// kha cig yul rnams kho na nyid kyis te// mi yi khyu mchog rnams ni byang chub byed// ces so// de yang nye rgyu'i spyod pa 'di nyid kyis/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang ster ba yin te/ ji skad du/ ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis 'chang*// khyab bdag dpe byad brgyad cur ldan// btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du// khu ba zhes bya rnam par gnas// de bzhin shin tu mchod 'os te// sems can kun la rjes brtse bas// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'dzin pa'i// sprul pa yi ni sku dag mdzad// de med na ni bde mi 'gyur// bde ba spangs nas de ma yin// khu ba'i rnam pa bcom ldan 'das// de yi bde ba 'dod mar brjod// de ni rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// nyan thos rnams kyi spyod yul min// sangs rgyas sras rnams spyod yul te// rdor pad las byung go 'phang ngo*// zhes so// de lta na'ang thun mong ba'i gdul bya'i ngor sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa spros bcas phyi'i spyod pa lus he ru ka'i 'dra 'bag tu 'jug pa sogs byed par ma nges te/

gsang sngags gsang ba'i sgo nas sgrub par byed pa'i phyir de skad du/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa bsrung*// nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'// zhes pa dang*/ nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can// mtshan mo shes rab brtag par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ dper na 'phags pa klu sgrub dpal mgon klu sgrub thogs med kyi spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad zer ba dgongs gcig rnying par bris 'dug pa khungs btsal dgos so// mchan/ dang*/ thogs med dang*/ jo bo rje dang*/ rje sgam po pa/ dus mkhyen/ phag gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sogs rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa sha stag yin pas/ skal ldan gyi ngor ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dang lhan cig tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin te/ jo bo'i rnam thar du/ 'brom dang nag tshos gsan par/ jo bo'i gzims chung du bud med mang po'i sgra shag shag pa byung ba ltar phyis dus ci yang mi snang bar jo bo ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs 'dug pa dang*/ rje phag gru pa'i mdun du yul gyi bu mo gzhon nu ma 'gro ba stag lung pas gzigs nas nang du bltar phyin pas 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa las gzhan ci yang ma mthong ba lta bu dang*/ theg dman phyi nyan thos dang thun mong gdul bya'i ngor theg dman so thar gyi tshul khrims gtso bor mdzad pa'i tshul ston pa ma gtogs/ sngags kyi spros bcas kyi spyad pa spyod pa'i tshul ma bstan pa bzhin no// de yang phyi nyan thos kyi spyod pa dang*/ nang du byang sems kyi spyod pa dang*/ gsang bar gsang sngags kyi spyod pa gsum gyi sgo nas gdul bya rigs can gsum rjes su 'dzin pa 'di ni sems can gyi don bla na med pa yin te/ rje sgam po pas/ kho bo la bla ma gong ma rnams las lhag pa'i yon tan ci yang med mod/ rten dge slong du yod pa 'di'i mthu las phrin las che ba byung zhes pa'i phyir/

nang gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyi 'dod yon la chags pa dang bral bar longs spyod kyang*/ phyi'i kun spyod 'dod yon la longs mi spyod par sdom pa 'og ma ltar spyod pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa mchog tu gyur pa'i don yin gsungs/// / ༈ rdo rje'i gsung*/ bhu sngags bla med kyi rdzogs rim gyi yang dag mtha' mngon du byed pa la lus shin tu spros med bhu su ku'i spyod pa med na zhi ba nyan rang du gol bar bya ba bton na/ rdo rje'i gsung lhad dang bral bar 'gyur ro// mchan/ su ku'i chos gsum med na zhi ba nyan rang yin/ zhes pa dang*/ de 'chad pa na/ spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba zhes pa la/ rtogs pa'i rim pa la rtse gcig spros bral ro gcig sgom med rnal 'byor bzhi yod pas/ de bogs dbyung byed kyi spyod pa'ang mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung gsung*/ bhu

bhu su ku ni za nyal 'chag gi sgra don du saṃskṛ ta'i ming yig thog ma btus pa ste/ bhu ni/ bhu dza na za ba/ su ni susta na nyal ba/ ku ni/ ku ṭam ga ma bshang bar 'gro ba'o// mchan/ bhu dza na zhes pa'i rgya skad 'di la dgongs gcig gi yig rnying rnams su dag ma dag ci rigs par snang gsung*/ slob dpon lū yi pa lta bu zhes pa la/ lo rgyus mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang*/ yang lugs gcig la/ nya pa'i shing spyil du gnas bcas/ nya'i rgyu lto bor bas 'tsho zhing 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyong gis bzhugs pa las/ je zhig na mtsho lud nas nya chen po zhig gis slob dpon khang pa dang bcas pa khyur mid byas te/ nya'i lto bar lo bcu gnyis phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub thob nas nya'i lto ba nas byon pas lū yī pa ste/ nya'i lto bar grags gsung*/ yang rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ni/ drod chen po'i lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig la/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi phyag rgya 'di la brten nas/ 'dis snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i nā dā stobs su gyur pas ye shes kyi stong bzhi 'od gsal du bsdus pa'i ngang las/ gzhom med rlung sems kyi nā da las sgyu lus bzhengs pa'i lam la gcig sgril du mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag rgya'i spyod pa'i don dam go chod nas/ dngos su spyod pa gsum ma mdzad kyang*/ spyod pas lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin par byas pa yin no// 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas yang na/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya la mi brten par/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi phyag rgya la brten nas spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin pas/ dpal sa ra has/ rmad byung nam mkha'i dkyil sha bhu su ku// stong pa'i gzugs mdzes ltos shig bhu su ku// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// mchan/ spyod pa gyis shig par lung bstan pa dang*/ phyag rgya'i spyod pa'i nye rgyu de la zla ba gcig gis mthong lam mngon du byed pa zhig dgos pa yin te/

ji skad du/ gnang ba rnyed 'gyur sngags pa la// rnal 'byor ma yis bstan par bya// phyag rgya che ge mo khyer la// sems can don gyis rdo rje 'dzin// zhes dang*/ zla ba gcig gis skal ldan par/ 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med// ces 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de lta bu'i nus pa dang rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan par spyod pa de byar mi rung ste/ dper na/ jo bo lha gcig bod du 'byon khar slob ma rnal 'byor pa zhig gis/ bdag spyod pa bgyi bar zhu zhus pas/ da rung ma ran mchi/ nus pa ji ltar bdog gsung ba la/ des lce spyang lnga brgyar sprul/ re res dur khrod nas ro re khar khyer/ lce yul ba cig byas pas ro dang lce spyang mi snang bar song bas/ jo bo'i zhal nas btub par 'dug gsungs pa ni lha dang bla mas gnang ba thob pa yin te/ de lta bu ma thob na de mi rung ba'i phyir/ yang slob dpon nag po spyod pa chen po de dus 'khor gyi rgyud phyi ma nas lung bstan pa yin yang*/ bla mas ma gnang bar spyod pa la zhugs/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya khrid/ gdugs bdun nam mkha' la rang 'khor du 'gro zhing*/ ḍa ma ru bdun gyi sgra rang grag tu byas/ shing ta la bdun srid du 'phags te/ gnas chen du 'byon pa'i lam khar/ mu stegs can phra men ma gnyis ljon shing bsrung ba la slob dpon gyis lta stangs kyis shing thog phab pas/ phra men mas slar 'byar bar byas pa/ slob dpon gyis phyis lta stangs kyis 'bebs ma nus pas/ phra men ma'i nus pas slob dpon la glags rnyed nas sku tshe'i bar gcod byas/ slob dpon gyis bar dor mchog gi dngos grub grub ste/ slar lus snga ma la zhugs nas phra men ma 'dul bar dgongs te byon pa na yul der rgyal khrims kyis ro zhag re las bzhag sa med nas/ slob dpon gyi spur bsregs pas slar 'jug ma thub pa dang*/ slob dpon 'bar ba'i gtso bo la'ang lo rgyus 'di 'dra zhig las phyis skye ba brgyud de mai tri par 'khrungs zhes grag

/ des na rnal 'byor pa de lta bu la'ang dus su ma bab par spyod pa'i nyes dmigs de 'dra na/ deng sang kha cig sngags kyi spyod par rlom nas/ mtshon bsrung dang khyi bsrung gi thabs tsam brten nas mi gcod gtong zer ba 'di/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i spyod pa rnam pa gsum gang du yang gtan gtogs pa ma yin te/ mi la gcod gtong zer ba 'di bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab ga na'ang zhal mi gsal kyang*/ bod 'dir grub thob smyon pa'i mtshan can zung byon pa phyin ma gtogs/ de phan chad ma byung bas lugs khyad par gyur pa zhig snang ngo*// mchan/ rgyud sde nas mi tshe hril po he ru ka'i chas zhugs kyi spyod pa 'di ma gnang ste/ spros bcas dang spros med dang shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum po la'ang*/ shes rab dang yo byad dang na tshod kyi sgo nas zla phyed dang zla gcig dang zla drug la sogs pa tsam du spyod pa'i dus kyi nges bzung mdzad pa'i phyir/ spyod bsdus las/ de ltar chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye ba dang*/ na tshod dang rjes su mthun par spyod pa rnam pa gsum zla ba phyed dam zla ba gcig gam zla ba drug lhag par gyur pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma nye bar 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la mtshan ma ni 'di dag yin no// gzugs phra ba dang*/ reg pa yang ba dang*/ khyab pa dang*/ yang dag par thob pa nyid dang*/ rab tu snang ba nyid dang*/ brtan pa dang*/ dbang du gyur pa dang*/ 'dod dgur bsgyur ba dang zhes bya ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ spyod pa grub pa na dbang phyug gi yon tan 'di dag thob par gsung na/ deng sang spyod pa mdzad par rlom pa rnams dbang phyug gi mtshan ma 'di lta bu grub pa'i spyod pa yin min rang rang gi sems la gsal ba de yin/ mchan gyis mchan/ spyod dang gcod gnyis kyi tshig don yang gtan mi 'dra ba tsam gyis kyang shes nus pa'i phyir ro// drod la sogs pa la brtan pa ma thob par spyod pa byed pa ni/

dpal gsang ba grub pa las/ dper na skyes bu la la zhig /sman dang sngags sogs mi 'dzin par// dug sbrul mgo la 'dzin byed pa// gshin rje'i khar 'gro kho nar zad// de bzhin de nyid med bzhin du// ngo mtshar che ba lta byed de// ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar// shi ba'i mthar ni dmyal bar 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/ khe nyen che ba'i gnas 'di la shin tu gzab par bya'o gsungs/ mdor na skabs 'di'i gzhan bzhed ni/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa la za nyal 'chag pa tsam las gzhan dge mi dge lung ma bstan gang yang 'du mi byed par gyi nar gnas pas grol bar 'dod pa yin la/ rang bzhed ni rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pa rgya chen po la 'jug pa na/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ rang don yid byed dang*/ tha mal dang mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pas skad cig kyang bar ma chod par/ snang grag rig myong thams cad bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pas dag pa rab 'byams kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs te longs spyod dgos pas/ dus der phyi'i spyod lam gyi cha nas za nyal 'chag pa tsam las gzhan 'jig rten dang thun mong du gyur pa'i spyod lam skad cig kyang mi spyod pa'i phyir 'du shes gsum pa'i bhu su ku pa'i spyod par ming btags pa tsam yin gyi/ 'di lta bu lam gyi gnad gzigs nas bu ston rin po ches sam+bu ṭa'i 'grel par/ de ltar shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ dbang po rab kyis ye shes kyi phyag rgya'am phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran zhing*/ myang 'das kyi bde ba 'dod pas tha na rgyal srid dang 'jig rten gyi dngos grub sogs lan chags pa spangs te/ lus srog la ltos pa med par spyad pas/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi yon tan brgyad 'thob ste/ brgyad ni/ rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo nyid kyi phra ba/ lus yang bas reg spangs pa/ 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag khyab par byed pas shin tu che ba/

sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thob pa nyid kyi gar yang phyin pa/ ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu gsal bar 'os pa/ de la brtan par gyur pa nyid kyis dbang po/ skye bo thams cad bdag nyid kyis dbang bsgyur ba/ 'dod dgur bsgyur bas gang du 'dod par gnas pa ste/ phra mo'i gzugs dang reg spang ba// khyab dang yang dag thob pa nyid// rab tu gsal dang brtan pa nyid// dbang ldan 'dod dgur bsgyur mtha' can// zhes so// bha dzā na/ sha yang lta/ gu ṭa/ bhu su ku'i spyod pa za ba dang nyal ba dang bshang bar 'gro ba tsam gyi bya ba la yang byang chub kyi sems bsgoms par bar ma chad du spyod pa shin tu spros med kyi spyod pas kyang spyad do// dbang 'bring gis/ las rgya lha mo'i gzugs can lnga'am gcig gis spros med kyi spyod pa spyad la/ dbang rtul gyis/ tha mal gyi nga rgyal med pa'i gzhon nu ma mdzes ma rnams dang*/ lhan cig the tshom med pa'i sems kyis/ phyag rgya glu gar la sogs pa'i sbyor bas rtag tu brtson pas nyin mtshan du spros bcas kyi spyod pas sgrub ste/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bzhin no// de gnyis kyang 'dir cung zad bstan la/ dbang rnon gyi shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni 'dir rgyas par bstan no// sgra ji bzhin pa'o zhes dang*/ de dang cha 'dra bar rje bo dong bas de nyid snying por/ spros med kyi spyod pa ni zhi gnas shin tu dben par rang nyid gcig pu kho nar 'dug nas/ nyin par sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ mtshan mo 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'am/ yang na sgyu lus su yang yang langs te bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bskyed pa dang*/ 'od gsal du yang yang bcug nas ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po spel te/ bhū su ku tsam gyi spyod pa bya'o// zhes zer ro// mchan/ nang du 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyi ngo bo'i sgyu lus dang 'od gsal zung 'jug gi sku grub pa'i slad du/

lam dus stong pa bzhi pa'i 'od gsal gyis ma dag pa'i sgyu lus su myur ba myur bar gnas bsgyur ba'i sgo nas/ gzhi dus kyi 'od gsal sgrib bcas sbyong byed kyi bsod nams tshogs sog gi spyod pa mi spyod pa ma yin te/ de ma spyad na tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// 'o na de sngags kyi spyod pas tshogs bzlums tshul ji ltar zhe na/ rje nā ro pa'i ka dper slob dpon chen po la ba pas/ lo ni bcu gnyis gnyid log te// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob// ces 'byung ba ltar/ mchog gi dbu mar ye shes kyi rlung sems gnyis phan tshun du nus pa mthu can du sbyangs pas/ sems 'od gsal chos sku dang*/ rlung sgyu lus longs spyod rdzogs skur 'tshang rgya ba de'i tshe rlung sems kyi sbyang ba khyad par can de nye rgyu rig ma'i spyod pas tshogs rdzogs pa'i dod kyi phyag rgya'i bya ba byas te sangs rgyas pa la ni/ phyi spros bcas kyi spyod pa la brten dgos pa ma yin te/ spyod bsdus las/ rim pa 'dis bhu su ku'i spyod pa la spyod do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ mchog gi dngos grub tshe gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i tshe yang*/ bsod nams tshogs sog gi spyod pa bhu su ku par grags pa bzhin no// des na phyi spros bcas kyi spyod pa la ma rag par shin tu spros med rlung sems kyi sbyor ba khyad can gyi spyod pas mchog gi dngos grub mthar phyin tshul ni/ spyod bsdus las/ de nas skye ba gcig nas gcig tu goms pas/ bdag med pa'i chos la bslabs pas rnam par bsres pa'i sbyor ba khong du chud nas rang bzhin gyi snang ba dang gcig tu 'dre bar bya ste/ rim pa 'dis don dam pa'i bden pa la dmigs par bya'o// de'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ phung po la sogs pa ni khams phra ba la gzhug go /khams phra ba ni yang sems la gzhug go

/sems ni yang sems pa la gzhug go /sems pa ni yang ma rig pa la gzhug go /de ltar sbyar nas gnyid log par byed do// de la dus 'dir ni sems dang sems pa ma rig pa la zhugs pa'i skad cig la dran pa brjed pa'o// phyis ni brjod pa yang med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid 'od gsal ba'o// yang grol ba na rlung gis rang bzhin rnyed de gang gi rmi lam gzhan dag 'byung ba ni/ ji srid rnam par shes pa mi g.yo ba de srid du gnyid log nas 'od gsal bar blta bya ste/ de ni so sor rang gis rig pa'i lus dang ngag dang sems dang bral ba'i don dam pa'i bden pa nang gi mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya'o// rim pa 'dis lus kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams bsad par bya zhing de bzhin nyid la gzhug par byas na skal ba bzang po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ spros pa dang bcas pa dang spros pa med pa'i spyod pa la ltos pa med par shin tu myur bar 'dir rang gi gzugs yongs su brje bar 'gyur ro// zhes bya ba'i don to zhes gsungs so// mdor na mdo sngags kyi sangs rgyas la yang chus bcus pa'i a ru ra dang*/ 'o mas bcus pa'i a ru ra ltar mchog dman gyi khyad yod par gsungs pa bzhin/ slob pa 'phags pa la yang khyad par yod par grub ste/ mdo sngags kyi tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa la mchog dman dang rgya che chung gi khyad zhugs pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang*/ grub chen karma pak+shis mo gho'i ding ri'i tshad ma las/ shes rab dri med rang byung rdo rje dang*/ sku lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'jam dpal gyi bar na brgyud pa yod kyang nyan med kyang nyan/ brgyud pa yod pa ni kun tu bzang po dang rdo rje 'chang tha dad med pa man chad nas/ da lta rlung sems 'dus tshul gyi nyams snang 'jam dpal yan chad du ye shes dbyings kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'o// brgyud pa med pa ni/

'khor lo lnga'i pho brang du rlung sems 'dus tshul gyis/ dbyer med lnga'i 'jam dpal mthong snang thos snang rang gis rang nyid la ston cing rang gis rang nyid la zhu ba'i nyams myong gi bye brag mtha' yas pa'i 'jam dpal dang tha dad med pa'i phyir brgyud pa med pa'o// de phyir mtshan nyid kyi tshogs sbyor dang gsang sngags kyi tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi bar na yang mtho dman gnam sa tsam rgyug pa ste/ mtshan nyid pa'i tshogs lam chen po mthar thug gi gzhung bshad byed pa'i yon tan gyis/ sngags kyi rnam rtog mthu brtas pa'i rlung sems 'dus tshul gyi tshogs lam chung ngu'i snga ltas tsam la'ang mi to na/ srin bu me khyer gyi 'od la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa yin nam min/ mkhas 'dod rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod/ ces gsungs pa yin no// nyon mongs pa shin tu phra ba 'dug na de yang spong dgos zhes pa ni/ nye rgyu'i spyod pa'i skabs su rig ma'i 'dod yon sogs la tha mal du rtogs na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur bas/ tha mal gyi zhen 'dzin phra mo'ang spongs dgos pa'i don yin gsungs/ slob dpon chos mchog gis dge 'dun gyi zhal ta mdzad pa'i lo rgyus 'di la slob dpon gyis zhal ta mdzad du dgongs re bzhin/ de ring tshul khrims la nyes pas ma gos na shing skam 'di las me tog 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod pas/ me tog khra phung phung yong ba la skabs shig na mu stegs gdug thogs 'khor 'bum gyis bskor ba zhig byung ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis brtul te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug pas dgyes ches te/ gtsug lag khang gi lde mig glad la bskor ba'i bag med pa la shor bas/ de nyin bden stobs brjod kyang me tog ma byung zer ba grags che la/ 'dir bkod pa'i gtam rgyud dang mi mthun par snang gsungs/

chen po bzhi ldan zhes pa la/ 'khor lo bzhi'i tshad med bzhi gang rung la ngos bzung yang rung gsungs/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan zhes pa la/ spang bya spangs pa'i 'gog pa thob pa ni bral 'bras dang*/ de stobs kyi yon tan ni stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad de so gnyis/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku ni theg chen pas 'di skabs kyi 'bras bu ni skyes bu byed pa dang*/ bdag po'i 'bras bu mtshan nyid pa yin la/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni btags pa ba yin te/ zag med kyi dge ba la rnam smin gyi 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes zer ro// theg dman lugs kyi byang sems so thar skye nges pa la gnas pa/ rten pho dang las kyi ngo bo zag bcas bsam byung gi dge ba dang*/ bsags yul sangs rgyas dang*/ dus sangs rgyas pa'i bskal pa brgya lus pa na gzugs sku'i mtshan dpe sogs 'phen par byed pas/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu mtshan nyid par 'dod de/ mdzod las/ de ni 'dzam gling 'pho gyur nyid// mngon sum sangs rgyas la sems pa// bsam pa las byung bskal pa brgya// lus pa dag tu 'phen par byed// ces 'byung ba'i phyir/ mchan/ tshoms dang po gzhan rkang du 'grel ba 'di la mchan brgya dang sum cu so gsum yod/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ de'i stobs kyi yon tan ni mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis so// nam mkha' mdzod ces sogs la/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i rgyur nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes sogs ni dper mtshon pa tsam yin la/ de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi phar phyin rdzogs pa'i rgyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi tshul khrims zhes sogs sbyar bar rigs te/ bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyur mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phyin drug rdzogs dgos pa'i phyir zhes gsungs/ zhi ba thob 'dod kyi sems 'dug na spangs nas zhes pa la/ rang nyid kho na zhi ba thob 'dod spong dgos pa yin gyi/

rang zhi ba thob 'dod spong dgos pa min gsungs/ gnas skabs kyi gzhan don zhes sogs la/ phyogs ris su lhung ba'i gzhan don nyan rang gis kyang sgrub la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis phyogs ris su lhung ba nam mkha' dang chos kyi dbyings gar khyab tu gzhan gyi don byed pa yin gsungs/ bdag po tshags su bcug nas zhes pa ni/ rang don gyi tshags su rtogs pa'i gdeng thob pa zhig gis gzhan don bya dgos pa'i don yin zhes gsungs/ rgyal ba'i tog gcig thub chen chos kyi rje/ rgyal mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i gsung gi mdzod// rgyal ba'i gsung gi snying po bsdus te gsungs/ 1 /'di tshul dpag yas nam mkha'i mtha'// 'phags pa'i 'dab bzang dbang pos kyang*// rtogs byar min na byis pa'i blo// bung ba'i gshog rtses ji ltar dpogs/ 2 /de slad blo dman brjed ngas pas// gsung bzhin la rtogs sgros nyams dang*// go rim 'khrugs dang sgro skur sogs// nyes tshogs gang mchis bshags par bgyi/ 3 /dge ba'i 'od dkar zla 'od zil gnon des// bzod med duḥkhas mnar ba'i 'gro 'di dag /mi bden bden rtogs 'khrul pa'i rgyun chad nas// dwags brgyud mchog gi go 'phang 'grub gyur cig 4 / khams gsum chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das dpal mi bskyod bzang po'i zhabs kyis skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i seng ge'i khri chen po la mngon par dbang bskur ba'i gdan rim bco lnga pa/ chos kyi rje skyu ra rin po che rin chen rnam rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas dang*/ rgyal ba gar gyi dbang po'i ngo bo dpal mkha' spyod pa dri med dpal ye shes kyi sprul pa'i sku/ dkon mchog yan lag gi zhal snga nas la sogs pa/ dag pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su bka' stsal pa zin bris su bgyis pa las/ lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms de dang po dge bar grub bo// maṅgalaṃ/// /

༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/ deng 'dir gsung rab rin chen 'phrul par du// bzhengs dges legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum du// bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dri ma med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdoms te mthun rkyen sgrub rnams dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring 'byor ldan zhing*// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// bla med rnam grol thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bstan 'dzin dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams// sku tshe'i rkyen gegs tha dag rab zhi nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med mdzad bzhin du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs gyur cig /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing*// nad mug 'khrug rtsod thams cad zhi ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags par// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho 'char bar shog /de'i mthus kha ba ris pa'i skye dgu'i yid// rnam dkar dge ba'i las la phyogs pa dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel te// dam chos 'dzin pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo yi// zhabs pad bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir myur bkod de// zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ror// longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang myur 'char shog /khyad par bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs dri med sa chen yongs khyab ste// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// sku tshe mi 'gyur tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan// phrin las mi zad nyi zla'i 'od dang sdeb// 'dus tshogs dge 'dun bgrang yas rgyu skar la// zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'bebs par shog /lha rnams mkha' la shis pa'i glu dbyangs len// 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i yun du 'tsho// klu rnams dga' bas nor 'dzin dbyig gis bkang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog

/ ces pa'ang 7 rgyal dbang karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje mchog dgung grangs bcu gsum steng*/ 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar ljags rtsom gnang ba'i rten gsum gsar bzhengs kyi dge bsngo'i smon tshig byin rlabs can no/// /
